Congratulations to State Representative–Elect Emily Gregory and State Senator–Elect Brian Nathan for flipping TWO seats tonight in the Florida Legislature.

This November, we’re going to break the Republican supermajority in Tallahassee and take back control of Congress.


Florida Data Geek ✝️🇺🇦🇬🇱 (@MappingFL)

With all but 200 to 300 ballots outstanding, DEMOCRATS HAVE FLIPPED DONALD TRUMP'S STATE HOUSE DISTRICT!

The district has a GOP registration advantage of 13%! #flapol





— https://nitt

Pam Bondi REALLY tried us. Didn’t work.

Video

Pam Bondi is holding a “briefing” with the Oversight Committee. I believe she’s doing this to evade her subpoena. It’s structured exactly like a hearing except she’s NOT under oath & there’s no transcription or video.

We just walked out. We’ll see her at her sworn deposition.
Congrats to my friend @DeliaRamirezIL for winning her primary! She’s rooted and ready to fight for the people. One of the most badass people in Congress.
